steps.zh: 装一个 Rust 二进制

steps.en: Start a session — new workspace, tabs and panes appear
steps.zh: 起一个 session——新工作区，标签与分屏就位

steps.en: Runs a server behind your terminal and shows a live hint bar for every key
steps.zh: 在终端身后跑 server，每个键都有实时的底部提示条

steps.en: Split, tab, float and stack panes following the hints — no grammar to memorize
steps.zh: 跟着提示条分屏、开标签、浮动堆叠——不用背按键语法

steps.en: Detach, or just let the SSH tab die
steps.zh: 主动脱离，或者让 SSH 那一页直接死掉

steps.en: Keeps the session and its processes running in the background
steps.zh: session 和里面的进程在后台照常活着

steps.en: Reattach from a terminal — or later from a browser via the web client
steps.zh: 终端里 attach 回来——或者改天用浏览器的 web client 进

value.en: Multiplexing without the archaeology: the UI teaches itself, and a token-authenticated browser is a second door into live sessions
value.zh: 不用考古的终端复用：界面自己会说话，token 鉴权的浏览器是进入活 session 的第二扇门

sources: README 'How do I install it?' (cargo install --locked zellij; prebuilt binary in PATH; OS packages)

README 'What is this?' (workspace for terminal users; layouts, floating and stacked panes, multiplayer, plugins in any language compiling to WebAssembly, built-in web client making a terminal optional)
zellij-utils/assets/config/default.kdl (bind "Alt n" { NewPane; }; pane/tab modes; Detach bound in mode blocks)

docs/web-client (built-in webserver off by default, 127.0.0.1:8082, login tokens hashed and shown once, HTTPS hard requirement beyond localhost, reverse-proxy recommendation, $ zellij attach https://my-server:8082/my-session)
